identity.statusNote: Newton 3 has been superseded by Newton 4, the current version sold on the official page; Newton 3 owners get a discounted upgrade path.

keyLimits.en: Perpetual license, no subscription; 50% student/faculty discount with valid ID.
Discounted upgrade price for existing Newton 3 license owners.

cautions.en: Newton 3 (the slug's originally researched product) is no longer the current sale version; the official page now sells Newton 4 at 249.99 USD, with a 99.99 USD upgrade price for Newton 3 owners. No public price for standalone Newton 3 remains on the live page.

capabilities.en: 2D physics simulation engine for After Effects: makes layers behave like solid objects with gravity, collisions, friction and springs.
Applies realistic forces (bounces, oscillations) to text, shapes and other layers without manual keyframing.

limitations.en: One-time purchase with no free trial mentioned; buyers cannot test before purchasing.
Plugin-only tool, works exclusively inside After Effects and adds no value without it.

unknowns: No free trial availability could be confirmed; the FAQ page was not fully accessible for a definitive answer.
Whether Newton 3 (the base slug's named version) is still purchasable standalone, or only via the Newton 4 upgrade path, was not fully clarified from the pages reached.
conflicts: The seed data (queue) describes this slug as 'Newton 3' with a 249.99 USD price and a separate 99.99 USD Newton 4 upgrade, but the live official page now sells Newton 4 itself at 249.99 USD with the 99.99 USD price being the Newton-3-owner upgrade discount, not a Newton 4 standalone upgrade fee from a different base. This should be reconciled at fusion time.
